up: Retrieve all activity records from the database for assay CHEMBL1613992. Return the exact activity values including the standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Include the compound ChEMBL ID and molecule type for each record.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.molecule_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613992'
  AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
